findings.detail: This preliminary candidate is intentionally byte-identical to origin/feature/n8-interior-planner. After the save-progress commit adds the current Caddyfile and safe two-file merge telemetry run, recreate or refresh the merge and recheck the zero-outside-N8 invariant before committing main.

The first npm test invocation lacked TEST_DATABASE_URL. A corrected rerun against the guarded loopback-only ephemeral PostgreSQL was still active at the review cutoff, so the mandatory test result remained pending.

notes: The full N8 replacement strategy preserves the latest feature tree and avoids combining the two conflicting applications.
Tracked files outside projects/08-interior-ai-redesign remain identical to origin/main.
The tracked project-local symlinks point back into the repository root toolkit as designed.
No credential contents were printed or inspected beyond targeted signature matching.
